summary.text: Frank Jereis is the Democratic candidate for New York State Assembly District 90 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican John Isaac.
His campaign website describes him as a lifelong Democrat and Yonkers resident who is chief of staff to Assemblymember Nader Sayegh.

paragraphs.text: Jereis lives in Yonkers, according to his campaign website, which says he is also executive director of the Yonkers Democratic Party and has been a Democratic district leader for more than five years.
The site also says he previously worked at the Yonkers Commission on Human Rights and has taken part in multiple Democratic campaigns.
According to the site, he is running to address the affordability crisis, invest in schools, lower utility costs, create more housing, keep streets safe and fix Tier 6.
Ballotpedia lists him as having advanced from the Democratic primary on June 23, 2026.
